text:
padma: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Partners asked for an exact canary week and what Optimize features will be usable in the UI during canary.

maria: Canary week is 2024-07-08 to 2024-07-12 for internal validation, then 2024-07-15 -> 2024-07-26 for partner cohort. GA target: end of August.

ken: Engineering scope: instrumentation dashboard (read-only), Optimize recommendations surfaced by API and shown in a modal (no history write), and conservative API batching defaults enabled. No dedicated routing or UI batching controls in this partner canary.

padma: Partners want pass/fail criteria. What will we publish?

maria: We'll publish: P50/P95 latency, 99th percentile CPU/GPU usage, 5xx rate, tokens per request delta, and a simple quality-check flag from nightly evals.

padma: Any DB migration risk for Optimize history that could delay GA?

ken: There's a small, backwards-compatible migration for recommendation metadata. Everything is feature-flag guarded. No expected delays.

padma: Owners: Maria -> partner comms + marketing blurb by Tue; Ken -> ops runbook and pre-warm plan by Thu; I'll coordinate partner invites.

ops-bot: scheduled: canary-dashboard:v2 -> staging 2024-07-05T17:00Z. Auto-notify partners after staging smoke tests pass.
